reasoning_content: The pkill returned 143, but that's because pkill matched the command line of the shell that launched it (the command string contains 'sva-studio-react:serve' as text). Let's check whether the app is actually down.

action.command: sleep 2; ps -eo pid,args | grep -E '[s]va-studio-react:serve|[r]un-executor.js' | head; echo "---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'live HTTP %{http_code}\n' --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>&1 || echo "app down (expected)"
